pairs.assumption_text: The speaker has access to reliable private opinions about the individual’s character.
pairs.claim_text: A GOP lawmaker has already agreed upon an unnamed candidate whom Good will not name due to concern about harming their candidacy.

pairs.assumption_text: Public support and private doubt can coexist without contradiction.
pairs.claim_text: There is large support for one particular individual among conservatives who can get to 218 votes and would do an effective job.
